reportedFailure: Uploaded turtle photo returned Unable to identify. Reproduced on the animal region of the supplied app screenshot; the original camera/photo file was not supplied.
cause: Species score below threshold was also used as turtlePresent=false. Output normalization then discarded the broader turtle result.
fix: Keep likely turtle detection separate from species identity. The Eastern species threshold and original model weights are unchanged. Unknown species, sex and age remain unknown.

originalModelDetection.note: Sum of existing turtle-class scores; not a calibrated probability. Community source labels and limited negative coverage do not establish general accuracy.

largerModelCandidate.reason: It recognized the reported screenshot region, but the additional cohort produced more mistaken species suggestions. Rejected as a replacement.

additionalEvaluation.cohort: Additional 2023 sightings from observers absent from development; frozen model and threshold

limits: The screenshot test is approximate because screenshot compression and cropping differ from the original uploaded photograph.
The reported screenshot was not used as a training example.
Broad turtle detection is not Eastern box turtle identification. The species trial remains unreliable and age/sex functionality remains unfinished.
